doc.title: Chico Freeman interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001

title: Closing remarks, teaching at the New School and goodbyes
summary: They wrap up, he mentions daily practice and teaching at the New School, and the interview ends.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Excellent. Well it’s been a fascinating conversation and I wish you all the best in upcoming events.
It sounds like when you look at your week it’s like different every day, right?
Yeah, a lot of things, yeah a lot of things. But I practice every day so that’s important. It has to be things that have to stay constant.
I hope your tours go great—
Oh yeah, I’m an educator. That’s one of the reasons I’m here. I teach at the New School.
And I may end up teaching at a few other, at another institution soon. I haven’t heard back so I’m not going to mention the institution.
Okay. They’ll probably call you about the same time the movie people do.
Don’t you just hate that, just waiting?
Right. Well thanks so much for your time today. And I hope the rest of your events go well. It’s been a pleasure.
